modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_allowance.value: Economy Class: one piece of hand baggage. Business Class: 2 pieces.

carryon_weight.value: Each piece of hand baggage must weigh no more than 7 kg.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Each piece must measure no more than a total of 115cm (l+h+w).

personal_item.value: In addition, in all cabin classes: one lady's hand bag, purse or pocket book, and a duty free item small enough to stow in the overhead bin.

infant.value: Passengers travelling with infants: one cabin bag of 56cm x 36cm x 23cm (115cm), up to 5 kgs, for the infant's food, toiletries and nappies.

modules.lede: An overweight cabin bag is taken at the boarding gate and charged an excess baggage fee.

modules.title: Checked baggage

weight_policy.value: Routes not to or from North, Central and South America (weight policy): Business Class 40kg, Economy Class 30kg, infants 10kg; bags up to 158cm/ 62 inch (length + height + width), infants 115 cm/ 45 inch.

piece_policy.value: Routes to or from North, Central and South America (piece policy): Business Class 2 pieces of 32 kg each; Economy Class 2 pieces of 23 kg each; infants 1 piece of 23Kg; each up to 158cm/ 62 inch.

max_piece.value: Regardless of allowance, no single piece may exceed 32kgs.

oversize.value: A bag over a total of 158cm (height + length + width) costs USD 50 per oversized bag, subject to aircraft type; sporting equipment is handled separately.

modules.lede: Your allowance is shown on your e-ticket; SriLankan notes there can be exceptions based on specific periods, routings and fare types.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: SriLankan's conditions of carriage give you a choice of remedies when it cancels or disrupts your flight, except as otherwise provided by the Convention.

rebooking.value: If SriLankan cancels a flight, does not operate it reasonably to schedule, fails to stop at your destination or causes you to miss a reserved connection, you can choose to be carried at the earliest opportunity on another of its services with space, without additional charge, or re-routed within a reasonable time on its own services or another carrier's, without additional charge (with the difference refunded if the new routing costs less).

refund.value: Alternatively you can take an involuntary refund: the fare paid if no part of the ticket was used; if part was used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the travel used; if your class was down-graded, the fare difference for that sector.

compensation.value: If you qualify, compensation is provided under applicable law and/or SriLankan's Denied Boarding Compensation Policy, a copy of which is available on request.

gate_close.value: Flights will not be held if you do not report to the boarding gate at least 30 minutes before the departure time.

phone_home_market.notes: Two pop-up notices on SriLankan's luggage page give different numbers for its contact centre: '24 Hour Contact Center +94117 77 1979 (Within Sri Lanka : 1979)' and 'Global Contact Centre +94 19733 1979'.
